transactionCacheEvidence.interpretation: The transaction cache contains an AX-element-keyed partial attribute table, a set of requested attributes, and a system OSAllocatedUnfairLock protecting the fallback UIElementCache dictionary.

prefetchedHit.interpretation: A transaction table hit returns a cache whose supported set comes from the stored attribute dictionary keys; attributes and requested transaction set are retained. coldConstruction.interpretation: Cold collection reads supported names, constructs a set, and combines it with a 20-attribute base set before additional policy and insertion passes. coldSelectionPolicy.interpretation: Start with supported/base intersection; insert supported DOM class list only on exact bundle identifier match. Insert every supported visible and selected group member. Identity lookup is guarded by DOM attribute support. The helper at 0x1006ed930 inserts, returning true for new membership and false for existing membership; it does not remove.

coldSelectionPolicy.limitations: Selection helper accepts an identity resolver; original provider/system identity acquisition and full transaction construction are not implemented by it.
